title: Missing Number In Arithmetic Progression
description:
In some array `arr`, the values were in arithmetic progression: the values `arr[i + 1] - arr[i]` are all equal for every `0 <= i < arr.length - 1`.

A value from `arr` was removed that **was not the first or last value in the array**.

Given `arr`, return *the removed value*.
constraints: The given array is guaranteed to be a valid array.
hints: Analyze the constraints and data structures appropriate for Missing Number In Arithmetic Progression.
Formulate an optimal state transition or traversal invariant.
Consider corner testcases and boundary limits.
